observations: Stainless steel built-in microwave/oven unit with a drop-down door, hinge on bottom.
Brand text 'KITCHENCRAFT' is visible embossed on the door frame in photos 2 and 3.
Interior shows a glass turntable removed/visible rack area and what looks like a grill element at the top in photos 1-3.
Interior surfaces show some dark residue/staining around the cavity walls and door seal in photos 2 and 3.
Unit is photographed outdoors on a metal stand against a shop wall, consistent with a resale/open-market setting.
No photo shows the unit powered on, display lit, or any digital readout active.
No photo shows a power cord, plug, or rating label with model/serial number.

claims.claim: Clean imported microwave with oven and grill compartments
claims.evidence: No import documentation or country-of-origin marking visible in any photo; 'clean' is contradicted somewhat by visible interior staining in photos 2 and 3.
No photo or clip shows the unit powered on, display lit, turntable spinning, or heating function demonstrated.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or heat at all
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the unit plugged in, display lit, and turntable/grill running with visible heat or steam

risks.risk: Grill element could be burnt out or missing despite being visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the grill element glowing when activated

risks.risk: Door seal/hinge may be loose or door may not close fully, causing microwave leakage
risks.proof: Photo/video of door closing flush with no visible gaps, from multiple angles

risks.risk: Interior staining could indicate heavy prior use, burnt food residue, or water damage to internals
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of interior cavity, especially corners and top near the grill, cleaned or as-is

risks.risk: No visible power cord or plug type (Nigeria uses UK-style 3-pin, imported units may need adapter or have incompatible plug)
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug

risks.risk: No model/serial/rating label visible, so wattage and exact spec are unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the rating label (usually inside door frame or on the back)
risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end of generic built-in microwave range for the Kitchencraft brand

proof_requests: Video of the unit plugged in and running, showing turntable spinning and interior light/display active
Close-up of the grill element glowing red when grill mode is activated
Photo of the rating/serial label showing model number and wattage
Photo of the door closed flush from the side to confirm no gaps in the seal
Close-up photos of the interior cavity corners and top, to assess staining and condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by brand and type (Kitchencraft built-in microwave with grill), but no photo or clip demonstrates it powering on or heating, and the interior shows visible staining, so per the rules it must be priced at worst case as not working until proof of function is given.
